migrationNotes: First release of Campaign 2 Case 01, runtime case heavy_hands, the Vressk centrifuge habitat at Kepler-442b orbit.

Frozen game baseline 29c3b222c53f51de11a3aa83e896a6d0ef6fb490, an approved species-tooltip presentation fix; campaign_2_data.js is byte-identical to the earlier 46b9387 baseline, so no case evidence changed.

Registered as Campaign 2 Case 01 ahead of Case 03, which was produced first as the pilot. Case 03 keeps its runtime case number and was not renumbered; only its registry displayOrder moved from 8 to 9 so the Case menu lists Case 01 first.

Learners meet the acceleration relationship through a labelled merry-go-round analogy rather than the habitat's own readings, which differ by less than a tenth of one percent across a 20 cm bed and cannot carry the idea at this reading level. The reported values are retained in the Teacher Guide.
No mathematics standard is claimed: the packet requires no calculation.
